parametrized_description: A lighting company makes desk-lamps and night-lamps. There is demand for at least DemandDeskLamps desk-lamps and DemandNightLamps night-lamps per day. Production is limited to MaxDeskLamps desk-lamps and MaxNightLamps night-lamps per day. A contract requires at least MinTotalLamps total lamps per day. Profit is ProfitDeskLamp per desk-lamp and ProfitNightLamp per night-lamp. Maximize profit.

DemandDeskLamps.description: Minimum expected demand for desk-lamps per day

DemandNightLamps.description: Minimum expected demand for night-lamps per day

MaxDeskLamps.description: Maximum production capacity for desk-lamps per day

MaxNightLamps.description: Maximum production capacity for night-lamps per day

MinTotalLamps.description: Minimum total lamps to produce per day to satisfy contract

NumDeskLamps.description: Number of desk-lamps to produce per day

NumNightLamps.description: Number of night-lamps to produce per day

constraints.description: Desk-lamp production must meet minimum demand.
Night-lamp production must meet minimum demand.
Desk-lamp production must not exceed capacity.
Night-lamp production must not exceed capacity.
Total production must meet contract minimum.

objective.description: Maximize total profit from desk-lamps and night-lamps.
